fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-11-01, a laptop and a bag of documents valued at around Rs. 60,000 was found missing from a premises near Amudham Layout Residential Colony. The time of the incident was given as 11:00 on 2025-10-29. The complaint was lodged by Dharani Thangaraj (9000000307). A witness, Arun Babu, reachable on 9000000379, was mentioned in the complaint. Udhay Muthu (9000000352), described as an intermediary, was also mentioned in the complaint. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. Items referenced in the complaint: a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly entered through an unsecured entry point.
fields.Keywords: property theft, valuables, morning, associate, witness, residential colony, witness statement
